name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme
benefit: > Remuneration 1. A consolidated amount of ₹ 75,000/- per month on pro rata basis, all-inclusive (including taxes), will be paid to every RA. There shall be an annual increase of ₹ 7,500/- subject to satisfactory performance. 1. RA shall submit execute bond as prescribed in the Advertisement.
_eligibility_text: 1. The candidate must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics / Communications / Telecommunications / Information Technology / Computers / Electrical Engineering or a related field with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA. 1. The age limit is up to 28 years for Graduates (BE/BTech), 30 years for Postgraduates (MTech/MS), and 35 years for PhD candidates. 1. The applicant must be an Indian National. 1. The preference will be given to candidates having a valid GATE score, postgraduate degree with minimum 60% marks, PhD in a relevant field, work experience of one year or more, or an internship of six months or more with NCCS/TEC. 1. The candidates who decline the job offer after selection will be barred from applying for the next two NCCS notifications. **Note :** A candidate who declines to join after the offer of appointment is issued by NCCS shall be debarred from appointment in 2 subsequent notifications issued by NCCS. <br>
